title: GCP-6.5 slot claim: no canonical cross-implementation COSE vectors
description: test/vectors/gcp_slot_claim.json is still the legacy string-keyed format (no COSE_Sign1, no claim_seq/expiry, not the new integer-key 1-7 map), and no Python generator emits the new format - violating the repo invariant that all implementations match test/vectors. Extend the GCP handoff generator (see generate_gcp_handoff_cose_sign1.py / capability_announcements.py, which the C verifier was byte-parity-validated against) to emit canonical slot-claim vectors (valid, tampered-slots, replay, expiry, conflict) consumed by the C host test and Python/Rust.
